items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: he said, I want you to be my orchestra leader, I want you to pick a band and be my orchestra leader

ctx.x: Yeah. But he had a Kaiser, little, funny-looking Kaiser automobile. So I come here on vacation and brought back a blue Cadillac. Now, something said, Jacques -- I was driving around the corner and hide it. One night I forgot my keys had had to run real quick, so I came late. I parked the car in front of his casino and told the doorman to watch it. I ran upstairs and come back down, the doorman had gotten Mr. Varna. Mr. Varna looked at it and said, but Jacques, that's your car? I said, no, my uncle loaned it to…
Yeah, that's an old story about them cars. (PHONETIC).
